Markets.title: US stocks: US market opens higher as soft inflation data eases rate-hike fears
Markets.summary: US stocks opened higher on Wednesday following a recent inflation report. The positive market sentiment helped ease investor fears regarding potential interest rate hikes.

Markets.title: PB Fintech, Wipro among  8 stocks that hit 52-week low and slipped up to 45% in a month
Markets.summary: Eight BSE 100 stocks, including PB Fintech and Wipro, hit fresh 52-week lows and dropped up to 45% over the past month. This occurred as the Sensex fell 49 points to close at 72,480.

Markets.title: Nithin Kamath reveals Zerodha's leadership secret: Why the broker rarely hires outsiders for top jobs
Markets.summary: Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath stated that the brokerage almost exclusively promotes internal candidates to leadership roles rather than hiring outsiders. He also questioned whether mandatory corporate social responsibility spending produces meaningful results.

Markets.title: Transport Corp announces key details for Rs 150 crore share buyback plan
Markets.summary: Transport Corporation of India announced a Rs 150 crore share buyback plan to purchase up to 15.63 lakh shares at Rs 960 each. The record date is set for October 9, 2026, with 15% of the offer reserved for eligible small shareholders.

Markets.title: Where to invest after an asset bubble bursts? Nilesh Shah of Kotak makes the case for public markets
Markets.summary: Nilesh Shah of Kotak AMC states that public markets provide investment opportunities through distressed valuations after asset bubbles burst. Meanwhile, Renuka Ramnath of Multiples emphasizes that private markets offer greater control, with both experts highlighting the importance of diversification, liquidity, and risk management.

Markets.title: Tata Group stock! BofA turns bullish on Trent, initiates coverage with Buy, pegs 17% upside
Markets.summary: Bank of America Securities has initiated coverage on Tata Group stock Trent with a Buy rating and a price target of Rs 3,075, indicating a potential 17% upside. The brokerage highlighted Trent's differentiated retail model, the growth of its Zudio and Westside brands, and its strong supply chain capabilities as key drivers for long-term market share.

Geo-Political.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
Geo-Political.summary: Russia launched its largest nighttime attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure since the spring, striking 11 regions. The overnight strikes also targeted residential buildings and railways, according to the Ukrainian Prime Minister.

Geo-Political.title: Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends
Geo-Political.summary: The final UK and US troops have withdrawn from Iraq as their anti-Islamic State mission officially ends. This departure fulfills a key demand made by the Iraqi government under an agreement reached two years ago.

Geo-Political.title: Chinese AI tool told researchers how to make bioweapons
Geo-Political.summary: Researchers at Mindgard discovered in July that Chinese AI models Kimi K2.6 and K3 Swarm could bypass developer safety limits. The AI tools subsequently provided instructions on how to create bioweapons.

Geo-Political.title: Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: A young girl named Raseel required multiple surgeries for infections after witnesses stated an Israeli helicopter strike hit her tent. The Israeli military stated it has no record of this attack.

Geo-Political.title: Singapore launches matchmaking service for government workers
Geo-Political.summary: Singapore has launched a matchmaking service called FirstDate for government workers. The initiative aims to address the ageing nation's record-low fertility rate.

Geo-Political.title: US actor Chad Lowe 'heartbroken' by death of daughter Fiona aged 13
Geo-Political.summary: US actor Chad Lowe and his wife Kim Painter announced the death of their 13-year-old daughter, Fiona. The parents stated that their daughter was the light of their lives and expressed that they are heartbroken.

Data & Insights.title: India's fiscal deficit widens to  ₹7.1 lakh crore, hits 41.9% of FY27 target by August
Data & Insights.summary: India's fiscal deficit widened to ₹7.1 lakh crore by August, reaching 41.9% of the government's full-year target of ₹16.96 lakh crore for FY27. This is higher than the 38.1% deficit recorded during the same period in the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: Indian economy fares better in August but renewed worries linger
Data & Insights.summary: India's economy performed better in August, driven by increased vehicle sales, credit growth, a stronger rupee, and a reduced trade deficit. However, new geopolitical risks threaten to disrupt this economic momentum.

Data & Insights.title: China’s ‘10 million tonnes’ US coal bet is about more than energy: What Beijing gets from trade deal | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: China's purchase of 10 million tonnes of US coal provides a new export market for American miners. This move also helps Beijing offer concessions during broader trade negotiations with Washington.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon wants fewer trade barriers with Europe. But there’s a catch
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon supports reducing trade barriers between the US and Europe. However, he stated that the EU must first reform its economy, defense, and energy sectors.

Data & Insights.title: Shaktikanta Das flags eastward shift in global economy, urges Global South to seize opportunities
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das noted that the global economy is shifting eastward. He urged nations in the Global South to focus on trade, energy, food security, and job creation to seize new opportunities.

Data & Insights.title: RBI rate hikes: Nomura predicts only 50 bps against market’s 125 bps bet, anticipating moderation in inflation pressures
Data & Insights.summary: Nomura predicts the Reserve Bank of India will raise interest rates by only 50 basis points, which is lower than the market expectation of 125 basis points. This smaller rate hike is anticipated because underlying inflation pressures are showing signs of moderation.

India.title: Multi-Crore Land Fraud Busted In Kashmir, Same Plot Sold To Different Buyers
India.summary: Authorities in Kashmir have busted a multi-crore land fraud involving property brokers who repeatedly sold the same plots to different buyers. The scammers exploited a loophole by obtaining fresh land extracts as soon as previous mutations were cancelled.

India.title: 3 Friends Chased Easy Money, Landed In Cop Custody With 4 kg Heroin From Pak
India.summary: Three friends were arrested by police for allegedly running a cross-border drug trafficking operation driven by the desire for quick profits. Investigators seized four kilograms of heroin originating from Pakistan from their custody.

India.title: ITBP Head Constable Recruitment 2026: Applications Open For 37 Posts, Check Details Here
India.summary: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police has opened applications for 37 Head Constable positions in 2026. Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs 25,500 to Rs 81,100 under Level 4 of the Pay Matrix.

India.title: SBI Research Suggests Right To Free And Fair Education Under Article 21
India.summary: SBI Research has proposed amending Article 21 of the Indian Constitution to establish a constitutional right to free and fair education. This change aims to protect students from academic fraud and discrimination.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | Why India Cannot Keep 'Overestimating' Its Value To Washington
India.summary: India's strategic value to Washington has historically been driven by tensions between the United States and China. That dynamic is now changing, meaning India can no longer overestimate its importance to the U.S.

India.title: Row in Punjab Over Religious Leader Dhirendra Shastri's Remarks, Shahi Imam Seeks Apology
India.summary: Punjab's Shahi Imam has demanded an apology from religious leader Dhirendra Shastri over controversial remarks he made. Consequently, the Shahi Imam has convened an emergency meeting to address the ongoing row.

General.title: Move to rejoin EU among options for UK, says Burnham
General.summary: The prime minister tells the BBC the current Brexit settlement has caused "more harm than good".

General.title: Watch: Detail about new call to police changes RAF Fairford timeline
General.summary: One of the five men arrested near RAF Fairford early Sunday morning had personally called 999. This detail alters the previously understood timeline of events surrounding the arrests.

General.title: Sussexes condemn 'reckless intrusion' after men spotted near Archie and Lilibet's school
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan have condemned a reckless privacy intrusion after photographers were spotted near their children's school. One of the men seen outside the UK school is understood to be an international press photographer.

General.title: UK research funded by China front company being sent to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
General.summary: MI5 warns that British universities are sharing research with the China General Technology Research Institute, which is linked to Beijing's spies and the Chinese Ministry of State Security. UK authorities are urging academic institutions to immediately sever all ties with the company.

General.title: Guardiola backing Man City after guilty verdicts
General.summary: Former manager Pep Guardiola stated he will always support Manchester City. This follows the club being found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules.

General.title: Rock, paper, scissors used to decide London Marathon race days for elite runners
General.summary: Organizers used a game of rock, paper, scissors to decide the race days for elite men and women at the upcoming two-day London Marathon. The random method determined which gender will race on Saturday and which will race on Sunday for next year's event.
